en: Sepia-toned historical postcard depicting an earthen fortification with cannons and artillery positions on a rough landscape, probably a battlefield scene. In the foreground are cannons on carriages set into earthworks and a broken wheel; in the background are open fields and distant structures. The overall style resembles an old illustration or photograph of a 19th‑century fort or skanse.
